title: compress SWAG/PCA posterior basis with Mirror factors
hypothesis: Factorizing a SWAG posterior basis into compact Mirror factors preserves NLL/calibration while reducing complete posterior bytes beyond native SVD basis compression.
physical_object: SWAG posterior mean and rank-16 covariance basis
mirror_coordinate: low-rank factorization code for posterior basis columns
logical_multiplicity: posterior samples reconstructed from a compressed shared basis
controls: Mirror factor code with identical factorization

development.selection_metric: predictive NLL, 90% coverage, covariance Frobenius error, complete serialized bytes

fresh.reason: no audit after exact native factorization alias

success_gate: NLL delta <=.02, coverage delta <=.03 vs dense, >=25% complete bytes saved, and better quality/byte frontier than native SVD factorization.
failure_gate: Any quality/storage miss or exact native SVD function/payload alias => FAIL for Mirror-specific value.
boundaries: No neural posterior, natural task, audit or production runtime claim.
Posterior sample count is not independent capacity.
